activity.notes: Representative year for Arkwright's Cromford mill in 1771, used as a marker for his role in organizing powered machinery and labor in the early factory system; this does not treat him as the sole inventor of the underlying technologies.

sources.title: Richard Arkwright — Science Museum Group Collection
sources.citation_text: The Science Museum Group describes Arkwright's mills and factory organization as a lasting element of his industrial legacy while noting the contributions of earlier inventors and collaborators.
